title: NUMA Studio script.json (one reel's pre-production plan; schema_version 1)
description: Written by the Scriptwriter (numa-scriptwriter skill) for every reel day, saved next to the SHOOT CARD in the Drive day folder, and read by /make-reel, the Librarian and shoot_card.py. One row of the month plan is the same object plus planning fields (kind, topic, sales, invites, collab, event). Card rules and timing beyond this schema are checked by `shoot_card.py script` (docs/CONTRACTS.md section 9). Keys starting with '_' are free-form notes.

day.description: Day of the month (the NN in the folder name).

title.description: Short title; also the end of the Drive folder name.

kind.description: A Trial Reel is tested on non-followers before it reaches the grid.

slot.description: Default-week slot id from `shoot_card.py month` (e.g. ask_the_dpt_reel).

topic.description: What the reel is about, for the 14-day no-repeat rule. Default: the title.

series.description: brand.json positioning.series id, or null for a reel outside the five series.

template.description: Template or preset id from skills/numa-scriptwriter/templates.json.

length_s.description: Target reel length in seconds, outro included (growth 45-60, atmosphere 15-30, never over 180).

outro_s.description: Music-only outro in seconds. Default config render.outro_music_only_s.default (7.5).

hook_text.description: The first 2 seconds: on screen in frame zero and spoken as line 1.

lines.description: The voiceover script, one short sentence (story beat) per line; line 1 opens with the hook. Words <= 2.3 x (length_s - outro_s).

voiceover_by.description: Who reads the script (a team.collective name), or 'generated' (Higgsfield voice) or 'none' (music-only reel with the script on screen).

photos.description: Optional extra stills worth grabbing while in the room (steam, a candle, the finished space); not numbered shots.

mood.description: e.g. 'calm, warm piano'. Music Library files are named mood_bpm_title.mp3.

source.description: folder: Katie may drop a track; library: Music Library by mood (or `track`); generate: Higgsfield makes it; natural: clip sound only.

track.description: A Music Library file name when one is chosen.

cta.description: On-screen call to action, matched to the day's goal (education reels: a save or send ask, never booking).

on_screen.description: Other on-screen text (kinetic type cards, labels).

share_line.description: A reason to send it ('Send this to your plunge buddy').

safety_line.description: true for cold and heat reels: brand.json claims.safety_line.text goes in the caption.

needs_consent.description: true when any shot shows a recognizable person (consent list only).

film_by.description: Batch-session date (before `date`); null when nothing needs filming.

caption.description: Draft caption and hashtags (numa-caption skill); the Copywriter finalizes on build day.

sales.description: A sales-focused reel (at most one a week). Default: goal == offer.

invites.description: Invites people in (booking, 'come in', an event). Never on a closure day. Default: derived from goal and CTA.

collab.description: Collab partner name (brand.json positioning.collab_partners or a team.collective provider), posted as a collab, never a repost.

event.description: Event name for teasers, recaps and capture moments (brand.json offerings.events).

signature.description: The month's signature transformation or reveal reel.

folder.description: Drive day folder name: Day NN - YYYY-MM-DD - Title.

n.description: Shot number on the card, 1..N in order.

line.description: The script line (1-based) this shot plays under.

what.description: What to film, in plain words ('a hand touching the water surface, slow').

seconds.description: How long to hold (5 s by default).

people.description: A recognizable person: marked 'consent list only' on the card.

ai_motion.description: The one hero shot that gets AI motion (exactly one per reel).

source.description: new: Katie films it; library: reused from the media library (not on the card's list).

library_tags.description: Tags for a repeatable shot (filmed once, reused): 'plunge room, empty, lights on'.

during.description: A class or event on the calendar to grab this during (capture moment).
